_absent_assets.trigger: Re-review whenever a recipe path recorded here is restored, relocated or removed; the recorded list must keep matching the measurement.

audit_runbook.trigger: Re-review when the audit runbook is next executed; wire or retire.

audit_tooling.trigger: Re-review at the next audit batch; wire into the audit lane or retire.

browser_acceptance_probe.trigger: Re-review when the affected surface's browser acceptance lane next runs; wire it into that lane or retire it.

candidate.trigger: Wire-or-retire before it can support acceptance; re-review whenever a batch changes the make or scripts surface it belongs to.

ci_legacy_tooling.trigger: Superseded CI tooling; retire at the next CI cleanup batch.

demo_runbook.trigger: Re-review when demo data is next rebuilt; wire or retire.

diagnostic_cli.trigger: Re-review when the runbook that names it changes or a lane adopts it; otherwise retire. Not a gate.

frontend_develop.trigger: A hand-typed developer loop, not lane-dispatched; re-review when the frontend dev workflow changes.

gate_candidate.trigger: A candidate for a gate; wire it into a lane or drop it at the owning batch's review.

history_probe_runbook.trigger: A historical probe kept for recovery; re-review when the owning batch decides wire-or-retire.

local_diagnostic.trigger: Re-review when a local diagnostic runbook changes or the target is promoted into a lane; otherwise retire.

migration_runbook.trigger: Re-review when the migration policy or the customer migration collateral changes; wire or retire.

one_shot_projection_write.trigger: One-shot projection write already run; retire once the projection is frozen.

one_shot_replay_adapter.trigger: One-shot replay adapter; retire when the replay is confirmed done.

ops_runbook.trigger: Re-review when the ops runbook is next executed; wire or retire.

ops_tooling.trigger: Re-review when the ops runbook that owns it changes; wire or retire.

package-marker.trigger: The file is required structure, not debt; re-review only if its package's role changes or CI stops importing the package.

product_tooling.trigger: Re-review when the owning product batch wires it; otherwise retire.

release_runbook.trigger: Re-review before the next release; wire into the release lane or retire.

runtime_audit_probe.trigger: Re-review when the audit lane that consumes it is defined, or when an audit runbook invokes it; otherwise wire or retire.

tenant_runbook.trigger: Re-review when tenant provisioning/migration next runs; wire or retire.
